title: Market Research & Competitive Analysis
body:
### Description

Conduct comprehensive market research to understand target audience, market size, and competitive landscape.

### Software product launch context

This phase establishes the foundation for the product by understanding market needs, defining requirements, and creating a comprehensive project plan.

### Key steps

- Identify target customer segments and personas
- Analyze competitor products and pricing
- Research market trends and opportunities
- Document market size and growth projections
- Identify key differentiators and value propositions

### Dependencies

- Upstream tasks: None (starting task)

### Deliverable

Market Research Report

### Acceptance criteria

- Market research report is completed and reviewed by stakeholders
- Target personas are clearly defined
- Competitive analysis includes at least 5 major competitors
- Market opportunity is quantified with data
- Findings are documented and stored in project workspace
